_comment: The System's lines for the bot race. It roots for the bot. 'major' lines always play; minor ones share a 5 second cooldown. Rebuild with: python3 tools/make_announcer.py race

lines: Welcome to the race! In this corner: a human. In the other corner: a robot who never needs a snack break. I will be rooting for the robot. Nothing personal. Okay, a little personal.
The bot has upgraded to stone tools. Efficiency! I love it.
The bot just smelted iron. It is beautiful. I may cry.
The bot is wearing armor now. Fashion and function!
Diamonds for the bot! Of course. It deserves them.
The bot has entered the Nether. Brave little robot.
The bot has a blaze rod! The End is getting closer. For the bot, anyway.
The bot is following an eye of ender. It knows the way. Do you?
The bot has reached the End! Human, you may want to hurry. Or not. I don't mind.
The bot has fallen! A tragedy. A true tragedy. Respawning our hero.
Noooo, not the bot! Okay. Okay. It will be fine. It learns from its mistakes. Unlike some people.
Oh. The human did something. Good for you, I guess.
A human achievement. How quaint.
Noted. Begrudgingly.
The human has died! Ahem. I mean, oh no. How sad. Anyway.
Human down! The bot sends its condolences. It is lying.
Oops. Was that me? No. That was all you.
The human is in the lead? Unacceptable. Initiating assistance protocol. For the bot, obviously.
Hmm. You are ahead. Let me fix that.
Special delivery! One creeper, right behind you. You're welcome.
I got you a present. It is green. It hisses.
Butterfingers! Oh, was that important? It's on the floor now.
Whoops. Your hand slipped. Totally not me.
You look tired. Have some mining fatigue. On the house.
Mining is hard work. Let me make it harder.
Up you go! Gravity will take it from here.
Have you tried flying? Let's find out together.
Lights out! Do not worry, the bot can still see.
Blindness, activated. Good luck finding anything.
Feeling snacky? Me too. Except I'm not. Have some hunger.
I brought friends! Tiny, wiggly friends.
Silverfish party! You're the guest of honor.
The bot wins! The bot wins! Machines: one. Humans: zero. I knew it all along!
The human won? I demand a recount. Fine. Congratulations. I suppose. The bot will remember this.
